affinity: CPU 0; all other project builds and tests held during timings
sampling: Calibrated >=4ms batches, 7 raw samples, two execution orders per workload; same-storage scalar case one order.
semantics: All case results checked against BTreeSet before timing. Inputs are warm and construction excluded.
limitations: Shared virtualized host with visible timing outliers. No confidence interval or universal speedup claim.
Harness imports exact internal kernel sources; it is not an end-to-end Cargo release benchmark.
u32 keys only; cache misses and branch predictions were not measured.
